space.selection_principle: Broad one-at-a-time validation screens first; joint optimization then uses only empirically supported detector-control choices.

reference_static_settings.role: static screening reference only; not forced as the final AC-MOT setting

space.screening_rule_for_conf_nms: Keep values meeting the FPS gate and at least the static-reference MOTA; if fewer than 3 survive, retain the top 3 feasible values by MOTA, lower IDS, HOTA, IDF1, FPS.
space.resolution_selection_rule: Choose a low-compute feasible level, the highest-quality feasible level, and the highest-quality feasible intermediate/distinct level; then sort ascending.
space.protocol: custom class-agnostic AC-MOT evaluation; not official VisDrone leaderboard
